# Differential cases for the helpers check_db() (olympia/check.c) calls, at
# G3 6a25f2d252ce45bd5adbe3baaccb3be3eed56279: the names of olympia/code.c
# (display_name, box_name, just_name, plural_item_name) and cap(); the
# here lists, stacks and location walks of olympia/loc.c and stack.c;
# set_lord() and is_unit() (swear.c) with the command loading set_lord()
# does (init_load_sup() and what it calls in input.c and order.c, and
# touch_loc() in day.c); skill_school() (use.c); restore_stack_actions()
# (move.c); loc_depth() and clear_temps() (u.c); safe_qsort() with
# int_comp(); the attribute macros of oly.h; and the loops of loop.h.
#
# tools/helper-compat/run.sh feeds this file to a C driver built from the
# pinned sources and records its output in helper-c-output.txt;
# TestHelperMatchesC feeds it to the Go port and requires the same output.
#
# Each "section NAME" line starts a section. Every section runs in a fresh
# process (a fresh world, after glob_init()), so a section may end in a
# failed assertion: the driver prints what asfail() prints and the process
# aborts, and run.sh adds "exit STATUS" after each section. stderr goes to
# the same place as stdout, in order.
#
# One operation per line; a line that starts with '#' is a comment, and
# blank lines are skipped. Numbers are read with strtol(s, NULL, 0). TEXT is
# the rest of the line after one space, with \xHH and \\ escapes; with no
# space it is empty.
#
# Setting up (raw writes, no checks):
#   alloc N K SK        alloc_box(N, K, SK)
#   delete N            delete_box(N)
#   setname N TEXT      set_name(N, TEXT)
#   where N L           p_loc_info(N)->where = L
#   here L N            append N to the here list of L
#   lord N L            p_char(N)->unit_lord = L
#   prevlord N L        p_char(N)->prev_lord = L
#   units PL N          append N to p_player(PL)->units
#   unititem N I        p_char(N)->unit_item = I
#   plural N TEXT       p_item(N)->plural_name = TEXT
#   whohas N W          p_item(N)->who_has = W
#   req SK R            p_skill(SK)->required_skill = R
#   learn SK T          p_skill(SK)->time_to_learn = T
#   moving N V          p_char(N)->moving = V
#   prisoner N V        p_char(N)->prisoner = V
#   cmd N WHO STATE PRI p_command(N) with who, state and pri set
#   order PL N TEXT     queue order TEXT for unit N in player PL's orders
#   turn T              sysclock.turn = T
#   temp N V            bx[N]->temp = V
#   inv N I Q           append item I, qty Q, to bx[N]->items
#
# Under test:
#   names N             display_name, box_name and just_name of N
#   pluralname I Q      plural_item_name(I, Q)
#   cap TEXT            cap(TEXT)
#   depth N             loc_depth(N)
#   inhere L N          in_here_list(L, N)
#   addhere L N         add_to_here_list(L, N)
#   remhere L N         remove_from_here_list(L, N)
#   parent N, leader N  stack_parent(N), stack_leader(N)
#   school SK           skill_school(SK)
#   isunit PL N         is_unit(PL, N)
#   player N            player(N)
#   subloc N, viewloc N subloc(N), viewloc(N)
#   firstchar L         first_character(L)
#   garrison L          garrison_here(L)
#   parsearg WHO TEXT   parse_arg(WHO, TEXT)
#   setlord N L K LEV   set_lord(N, L, K, LEV)
#   restore N           restore_stack_actions(N)
#   touch N             touch_loc(N)
#   initload N          init_load_sup(N)
#   clear K             clear_temps(K)
#   macros N            noble_item, char_moving, is_prisoner, item_unique,
#                       learn_time and req_skill of N
#   sort N...           safe_qsort() of the numbers with int_comp
#   loop here L | stack N | inv N | kind K | units PL
#                       loop_here, loop_stack, loop_inv, loop_kind and
#                       loop_units, printing what each visits
#   dump N              the fields of box N the helpers read or write
#   queues              load_q[0..4] and run_q of input.c
